name: keyvault
description: A local, encrypted vault for developer keys and passwords — one file, a Tauri desktop app and a CLI. libsodium only.
author: Lior Medan

scripts.build:backend: esbuild src/backend.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=app/src-tauri/resources/backend.mjs --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
